title: Planning status rules
subtitle: How a visit moves between stages, and who may do what.

governance.heading: Governed by workflow configuration
governance.body: Status transitions are defined by the published workflow configuration and enforced by the database. This screen is read-only; changes go through the governed publish flow.

fallback.heading: Showing the standard reference
fallback.error: The live rules could not be read. What you see below is the standard set of stages, kept here as a reference, and it may be out of date.
fallback.none: No rules have been published yet. What you see below is the standard set of stages, kept here as a reference, and it may be out of date.

guards.republish: The planner is allowed to publish

sections.transitions: How a visit moves between stages

publish.label: Publish a plan
publish.effect: Make a visit plan live so an inspector can act on it

manage.label: Create and edit plans
manage.effect: Build and change visit plans before they go live

cancel.label: Cancel a visit
cancel.effect: Cancel a planned visit, giving one of the approved reasons

reassign.label: Change the inspector
reassign.effect: Give a planned visit to a different inspector

reschedule.label: Change the dates
reschedule.effect: Move the window a planned visit must be carried out in

capabilitiesNote: What each role is allowed to do is managed under Users and roles.

error.heading: Couldn't load the status rules
error.body: The status rules are temporarily unavailable. Reload to try again.
